The skills on this page are operations your pod runs, called over HTTP. They are not
[agent skills](/docs/agents/skills), which are folders of instructions that teach an AI client how to use Synap.

## What it is

A skill is a named operation stored on your pod, with an input schema. You call it like a typed function: you send
`input` as JSON and get a JSON `result` back. No language model sits between you and the call.

Use it from a script, a scheduled job or your own app when you want the same operation every time, under the
permissions of the key that calls it.

## Get an API key

Create an [API key](/docs/build/api-keys) with the scope `skills.invoke`. Give it full access: a key whose grant is
limited to some kinds, spaces or objects is refused on these routes (`403 GRANT_DOOR_UNSUPPORTED`).

The key is shown once, when you create it.

## List your skills

```bash
curl https://pod.example.com/api/external/skills \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <api-key>"
```

The answer is an array of the active skills the key's user can see. It also includes instruction skills
(`kind: "instruction"`), which hold text for agents rather than an operation:

```json
[
  {
    "id": "0b6f1c9e-2d4a-4e8b-9c1a-5f3e7d2a1b00",
    "name": "Summarize overdue tasks",
    "description": "Returns a summary of the overdue tasks in a space.",
    "scope": "workspace",
    "parameters": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": { "workspaceId": { "type": "string" } },
      "required": ["workspaceId"]
    },
    "executionMode": "sync",
    "timeoutSeconds": 30,
    "kind": "code"
  }
]
```

`parameters` is the JSON Schema of the skill's `input`. Call a skill by its `id`; its name is not accepted in the
URL.

## Invoke a skill

```bash
curl -X POST https://pod.example.com/api/external/skills/<skill-id>/invoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <api-key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "input": { "workspaceId": "<workspace-id>" } }'
```

A skill that ran answers:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "result": { "…": "what the skill returned" },
  "correlationId": "<id>",
  "ackState": "applied"
}
```

`result` is whatever the skill returns. `input` is optional; an empty body runs the skill with no input.

## Who can see a skill

Each skill has a scope:

| Scope | Who can list and invoke it |
|-------|-----------|
| `pod` | Every user of the pod |
| `workspace` | Members of the skill's space |
| `user` | Only the user who owns it |

A key acts for a user (for an agent's key, the person the agent works for). A `user` skill that belongs to someone
else, or a `workspace` skill in a space that user is not a member of, answers `404`, as if it did not exist.

## Governance

An invocation goes through the same governance check as any other run of a skill. If the key belongs to an agent, the
pod decides whether the run goes ahead, waits for a person, or is refused (see the
[validation policy](/docs/concepts/validation-policy)). When the run needs a person's approval, nothing runs yet: the
pod answers `202` with a proposal, and the skill runs when a person approves it.

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "proposed": true,
  "proposalId": "<id>",
  "reviewUrl": "<url>"
}
```

## Errors and other answers

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| `200` with `success: false` | The skill ran and failed. The body has an `error` message. |
| `202 Accepted` | Nothing ran yet: the run became a proposal (see above). |
| `400 Bad Request` | The request body is invalid, or the skill exists but is not active. |
| `401 Unauthorized` | The API key is missing, invalid or expired. |
| `403 Forbidden` | The key lacks the `skills.invoke` scope, its grant is narrower than full access (`GRANT_DOOR_UNSUPPORTED`), its person is a guest of the pod, or the pod's governance refused the run. The `error` says which. |
| `404 Not Found` | The skill does not exist, or the key's user cannot see it. |
| `429 Too Many Requests` | The key's rate limit is reached. |
| `502 Bad Gateway` | The pod could not execute the skill. |

## TypeScript example

```typescript
const POD_URL = 'https://pod.example.com';
const API_KEY = process.env.SYNAP_API_KEY;

async function invokeSkill(skillId: string, input: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const res = await fetch(`${POD_URL}/api/external/skills/${skillId}/invoke`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${API_KEY}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ input }),
  });

  if (res.status === 202) return { proposed: true, ...(await res.json()) };
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${res.status} ${await res.text()}`);

  const data = await res.json();
  if (!data.success) throw new Error(`Skill failed: ${data.error}`);
  return data.result;
}
```
